{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kappela Dynasty''' was the final dynasty to rule over the [[Tapani Empire]]. The [[Emperor (Tapani)|emperors]] of this dynasty presided over a steady decline into regional factionalism. The final end of the empire came in 1,582 BBY (11,138 Tapani calendar) when a cadre of military officers staged a coup and placed the government of the sector into the hands of a group of reformers.
